description: Returns what each trust's monthly trustee report (Form 10-D) said about one loan, month by month, for about the last year: the special servicer's comment facts with a short excerpt, resolution strategy, transfer and return dates, foreclosure, bankruptcy and REO dates, appraisal values and reductions, advances and modifications, and what changed from the previous report. Use it after get_loan to see what happened to a loan and what changed this month. Without a paid cmbs.news plan it returns a plan notice.

slug.description: The loan slug: the last part of its cmbs.news URL, from search_loans

name: get_loan_servicer
title: What the trustee reports said about a loan
